description: For either equality mode and complete \(R\), translate the very same supplied native public intuitionistic tree over \(X\sqcup\mathbb N\) by \(\mathcal T_{R[\mathrm{inl}],u_0}\), then use only formula and context renaming identities. The resulting public certificate proves \(\Gamma^{[R]}\Rightarrow F_R(A)\) and needs no original term.
